activity.notes: Bashar al-Assad was formally sworn in as President on 17 July 2000. His rule ended on 8 December 2024 when the Syrian opposition captured Damascus and the Assad government collapsed.

sources.title: Reuters — Bashar al-Assad sworn in as Syrian president, July 2000
sources.citation_text: Reuters archival reporting records Assad's formal swearing-in as president on 17 July 2000.

sources.title: Reuters — Syrian rebels topple Bashar al-Assad, 8 December 2024
sources.citation_text: Reuters reporting on the fall of Damascus records the end of Assad's 24-year rule on 8 December 2024.
